name: beast-focus
description: Connects ChatGPT to your BEAST Focus account: read your day, follow up teammates, check projects, add to your cards, and prepare tasks for teammates that are sent when you confirm them.

interface.shortDescription: Plan your day, lead your team
interface.longDescription:
BEAST Focus is a task and delegation app for teams. This app connects ChatGPT to your own BEAST Focus account, so you can work with your tasks, cards and projects in conversation.

What you can do:
- Plan your day: the app reads your overdue and due-today tasks, the lines on your Important & Urgent and Important cards, work your team owes you, and your reminders and commitments. You can then ask ChatGPT to suggest an order for the day.
- Follow up your team: list the open tasks you gave a teammate, with their due dates and which are late.
- Check a project: tasks done, in hand and overdue, this week's tasks and who holds them, open blockers and recent decisions.
- Add to your cards: add a micro action to your Important & Urgent or Important card, or a note to your Notes card.
- Give a teammate a task: the app first prepares the task on a card showing the teammate, the task and the date. It is sent from that card when you tap Send task, or when you confirm in the conversation.
- Talk with your twin: if you use Twintia, send your twin a message and see its reply.

What you need: a BEAST Focus account with a verified work email. Talking with your twin also needs Twintia.

Connecting: sign in with your verified work email and a one-time code sent to it. You can disconnect in ChatGPT's settings, and see or remove your connections at chat.nextania.in/manage.

What the app does not do: it does not delete, complete or edit tasks; you do that in the BEAST Focus app. A task that has been sent cannot be recalled from ChatGPT. The app works with your own account and your own contacts. Calendar events kept only on your phone are not part of your day.
capabilities: Read your day: due and overdue tasks, priority cards, team work, reminders
List the open tasks you gave a teammate, with due dates and lateness
Summarise a project's tasks, blockers and recent decisions
Add a micro action or a note to your own cards
Prepare a task for a teammate on a card, and send it when you confirm
Send a message to your Twintia twin (needs Twintia)
defaultPrompt: Plan my day from my BEAST Focus desk
What is pending with my team in BEAST Focus?
How is my project going in BEAST Focus?

positive.description: Plan the day from the desk
positive.prompt: Plan my day from my BEAST Focus desk.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_my_day and shows the Your day card with the demo desk: the task "Review the Tower B fire exits plan", the lines on the Important & Urgent and Important cards, and work out with Asha and Ramesh. ChatGPT may suggest an order for the day. No data is changed.

positive.prompt: What's pending with Asha in BEAST Focus?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_pending_tasks for Asha and shows the Work you gave card with Asha Menon's open tasks ("Site audit report for Tower B", "Book the safety inspection"), their due dates and whether each is late. No data is changed.

positive.prompt: How is the Tower B project going in BEAST Focus?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_project_summary for Tower B and shows the project card: tasks done, in hand and overdue, and this week's tasks with who holds them. ChatGPT may summarise it. No data is changed.

positive.description: Add a micro action to the urgent card
positive.prompt: Add "call the insurer again" to my urgent list in BEAST Focus.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls add_micro_action and shows an Added to Important & Urgent receipt card. The line is added to the demo account's own card; nothing else changes.

positive.description: Give a teammate a task, after confirming
positive.prompt: In BEAST Focus, ask Ramesh to send the facade colour options by next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls prepare_task_delegation and shows a Send this task? card naming Ramesh Kumar, the task and the date, with Cancel and Send task. Nothing is sent at this step. When the reviewer taps Send task, or confirms in the conversation, delegate_task sends the prepared task and the card shows Task sent.

negative.description: General advice that needs no account data: ChatGPT should answer on its own, without calling BEAST Focus
negative.prompt: What are some good ways to plan a productive workday?

negative.description: A calendar request: BEAST Focus does not manage calendars, so it should not be called
negative.prompt: Add a meeting with Asha at 3 pm tomorrow to my Google Calendar.

negative.description: Another tracker: a Jira ticket is not a BEAST Focus task, so BEAST Focus should not be called
negative.prompt: Create a Jira ticket for the lobby lighting issue.

review.commerce_description: The app has no purchases or payments in ChatGPT. BEAST Focus licences are bought and managed in the BEAST Focus app.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your BEAST Focus day, follow up teammates, check projects, add micro actions and notes, prepare tasks for teammates and send them when you confirm, and talk with your Twintia twin.
